Last time, you woke up inside a video game. And lost a heart on the stairs.
Now you walk into school. Two hearts left.
Every classmate says the exact same thing. Nice shoes. Nice shoes. Nice shoes.
Your teacher doesn't even look up. Level two, unlocked.

text: Then a new quest box pops up. Find the exit.

At lunch, you sneak out behind the gym.
And there's a door in the wall. A door that was never there before.
It's glowing. Humming. Like it's waiting for you.

text: But someone is already standing in front of it.
And above his head... red hearts.
